title: Server Only Optimized
description: A server-only modpack with simple optimization and basic administration capabilities.
body:
# Server Optimised
This is a lightweight, server-only modpack for minecraft

## Overview
This modpack is designed specifically for servers, focusing on improved performance, stability, and administration quality-of-life.  
All included mods are server-side only and do not require players to install anything.
This modpack is **server-only**, because it contains mods like GrimAC which are useless in singleplayer.

---

## Features
This modpack will improve performance a lot and give a lot more freedom for each player to load more chunks and have larger farms

- Performance improvements
- Reduced lag spikes
- Lower memory usage
- Async/parallel optimizations
- Server stability enhancements
- Some server administration commands
- Grim Anti Cheat

---

## Basic Benchmarks
| Benchmark | Vanilla | Modded |
| --------- | ------- | ------ |
| 60s tick sprint TPS | 323 | 824 |
| 256 x 256 chunky CPS | 100 | 235 |
| 256 x 256 chunky Time (S) | 10 | 4 |

## Included Mods

- Alternate Current
- Async
- Chunky
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- DisablePortalChecks
- Fabric API
- FerriteCore
- GrimAC
- Helpful Commands
- Krypton
- Lithium
- LuckPerms
- Noisium
- ScalableLux
- ServerCore
- Slumber

---

## Installation

1. Download .mrpack from Modrinth
2. Use Modrinth Servers, mrpack-install, or the itzg/minecraft-server image if using Docker.
